mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final Earth-lighting views: Economy/High, noon/late, three distances, silhouette, six details, four matched whole-model levels and four transitions. Skyline retains open six-column portico and galleries, nave, rear chapel domes and detached tower/spire. District adds shared textures, recessed closed door, selected niche/figure fields, frames and flat bell/lantern panels. Street opens belfry/lantern arches and recesses niches; closeup refines columns, curves, mullions and figures. Whole-model cameras retain both structures; closer details crop intentionally. Two additional matched Economy/High skyline views confirm diagonal marks near front gallery corners are shadow artifacts, not stray geometry; those High shadow marks remain a rendering limitation. Detail changes are visible. Procedural neighbors are synthetic context, not local mapped buildings.
